gems.name: openc3-cosmos-constellation
gems.info: A CONSTELLATION target whose packets a bridge microservice fills from the Constellation feed: the next predicted pass, the next 24 hours, the soonest rain-fade swap to decide, a day's capacity across the antennas (CAPACITY), the next pass's MODCOD plan (MODCOD), and the run they came from. A Telemetry Viewer screen shows them all, and a Constellation Forecast tool charts each workflow.

metadata.openc3_store_keywords: forecast, ground station, pass prediction, rain fade, modcod, antenna capacity, scheduling
